export_note: Arrays longer than 64 items are omitted; retained values are unchanged. No metrics are recomputed.

data.inference: one original frozen SAM decode plus candidate ranker, tokens1..3 only
data.teacher: fixed four-prompt consistency choice; no GT quality labels used in distilled loss or epoch selection; benchmark prompts are annotation-derived, not annotation-free sampling
data.supervised_control: same architecture, training oracle choice; epoch chosen by validation meanIoU across original three regimes
data.candidate_permutation: shared pointwise scorer; sorted pairwise-IoU features; no candidate index feature
